definitions.parent-and-k1-denylist: Premium parent residual AX31 increment x shipped 2.5. Residual family added to K1 denylist. Brake otherwise unguarded.
definitions.parent-and-k1-guard: Premium parent residual AX31 increment x shipped 2.5. Residual K1 increment x shipped 2.5 on the brake. Denylist stays shipped.
definitions.residual-k1-denylist: Shipped unguarded Premium parent. Residual family added to K1 denylist. No new constant.
definitions.residual-k1-guard: Shipped unguarded Premium parent. Residual K1 increment x shipped 2.5 on the brake. Denylist stays shipped.
definitions.shipped: Fast 1.11, Balanced 1.45, Premium predicted cap 3.25, brake_ratio 3.25. Premium parent unguarded. Denylist korean_reasoning, python_program, rule_reasoning.

arms.selection: Among arms that clear every gate, prefer the earlier candidate (least added mechanism: denylist, then K1 increment guard, then those plus parent guard).

context_frozen.multiplier: family_guard_router.guard_multiplier; residual family other = 2.5. Do not retune from E7 leftover 4.034 or E8 non-monotonicity.
context_frozen.note: Cost heads, Fast/Balanced family guard, runaway_fraction, ExtraTrees stay shipped. Fast/Balanced must remain bit-identical to shipped.
context_frozen.prior: E7 and E8 closed the parent-multiplier grid. This protocol tests residual K1 coupling, the E8 failure mode.

decision_reasons.fail: No residual-K1 coupling arm cleared the pre-registered residual-cap, official-safety, Fast/Balanced identity, or Dev veto gates. Keep the current runtime. Do not add a post-hoc residual quantity cap in this protocol.
decision_reasons.pass: A residual-K1 coupling arm kept Fast/Balanced identical, held official Train/Dev off the near-budget line, and brought residual-only Premium under the official cap including inflation. This opens a promotion window only.

metric.definition: Official weighted final score on the full Train and Dev batches. Residual-only and other composition views replay the allocator. Fast/Balanced identity is bit-exact versus shipped.
metric.selection: Earlier sealed candidate among arms that pass every safety gate. Dev official score is a veto, not a ranking objective.

motivation.e8: Parent multipliers 2.75 and 3.0 freed brake budget and bought residual K1. Dev residual actual was non-monotonic and stayed above the inflated cap.
motivation.note: Uses only the shipped denylist mechanism and the shipped residual multiplier. Family-specific Fast patches remain forbidden.
